items.stem: A team wants its pipeline definition reviewed, versioned and diffed like code. What should they use?

options.text: A YAML pipeline stored in the repository
options.rationale: Correct: YAML pipelines are source-controlled and reviewable.
UI pipelines are not diff-friendly source.

options.text: Manual deployment scripts run by hand
options.rationale: Manual scripts are not a reviewable pipeline.
A spreadsheet is not executable or versioned as code.

items.explanation: Correct: YAML pipelines are source-controlled and reviewable.

items.stem: Which TWO controls help ensure only vetted changes reach production? (Select TWO.)

options.text: A manual approval check on the production environment
options.rationale: Correct: approvals gate promotion to prod.

options.text: An automated gate that queries a health/monitoring signal
options.rationale: Correct: gates block promotion on objective signals.

options.text: Granting every user permission to deploy to prod
Removing all tests to speed up deployment

items.explanation: Correct: approvals gate promotion to prod.

items.stem: A release must switch traffic to a new version instantly and allow immediate rollback to the old version. Which strategy fits best?

options.text: Blue-green deployment with a swap between two environments
options.rationale: Correct: blue-green allows instant cutover and rollback.

options.text: Deleting the old version before deploying the new one

options.rationale: In-place edits are not cleanly reversible.
Timing is not a release strategy.
